Quotes / Judah Halevi / Q0598

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with The Kuzari I (Hirschfeld / standard English), within the Jewish Rationalism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of faith, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Judah Halevi's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
